fields.description: Issue includes local political coverage and election commentary (including discussion of a recall effort and Miami city commission candidates), reporting on alleged labor and wage abuses connected to the Miami-Biltmore and Henry L. Doherty, and a campaign by major employers to resist illegal small-loan and salary-assignment practices. Also contains community columns, sports coverage (boxing at the Miami Beach Arena), Mothers' Day editorial content, and extensive local advertising.
